svg.title: tsrslint vs tsgolint 7.0.2005
svg.desc: Summed over 8 open-source projects · all 61 rules · 4-vCPU Linux machine. Lint time: tsrslint 29.2 s, tsgolint 131.2 s. Peak memory: tsrslint 12.1 GiB, tsgolint 47.9 GiB. Shorter is better. Per project: vscode: tsrslint 10.08 s, 2.63 GiB; tsgolint 37.37 s, 10.49 GiB. mui-docs: tsrslint 3.20 s, 1.57 GiB; tsgolint 24.82 s, 9.07 GiB. xstate: tsrslint 0.66 s, 506 MiB; tsgolint 2.20 s, 1012 MiB. webpack: tsrslint 0.71 s, 469 MiB; tsgolint 2.60 s, 1.11 GiB. cal-diy: tsrslint 1.93 s, 1.29 GiB; tsgolint 8.82 s, 4.44 GiB. formbricks-web: tsrslint 4.11 s, 2.30 GiB; tsgolint 17.42 s, 7.88 GiB. supabase-studio: tsrslint 4.01 s, 1.89 GiB; tsgolint 17.89 s, 7.04 GiB. t3code-server: tsrslint 4.44 s, 1.45 GiB; tsgolint 20.08 s, 6.89 GiB. xstate and webpack are in the release build's PGO training set. Median of 3 interleaved runs. Machine: GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 (4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 9V74 80-Core Processor). Measured 2026-10-26 13:03 UTC; tsrslint commit 7cec06124f4e53749c06e9669cf7d6531c2f772b (PGO dist build); stock tsgolint 7.0.2005 (npm @oxlint-tsgolint/linux-x64).
